items.title: 26.3 Polymer ki qism, repeat unit aur monomers pehchanna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of identifying polymers (PDF 152-154).

blocks.text: Skeletal ya structural formula se polymer pehchanne ke liye dohrane wala jor aur monomer units dekhein. Yahan sirf addition aur condensation polymers zer-e-ghaur hain.

items: Qism pehchanein: asal zanjeer (reerh) dekhein. Agar is mein sirf carbon atoms (-C-C-C-) hon to yeh addition polymer hai, jo alkenes se bana. Agar carbon ke saath oxygen ya nitrogen bhi ho to condensation polymer hai. O ke saath C=O ester link (polyester, maslan PET) dikhata hai; N-H ke saath C=O amide (peptide) link (polyamide, maslan nylon-6,6 ya Kevlar).
Repeat unit dhoondein: dekhein ke silsila kahan dohrana shuru hota hai, aik dohrane wale hisse ke gird brackets lagayein aur subscript n likhein.

Monomer(s) dhoondein: addition polymer ke liye repeat unit ka C-C single bond wapas C=C mein badlein. Condensation polymer ke liye paani wapas daalein: ester ya amide bond torein, C=O wali taraf -OH aur O ya N wali taraf -H lagayein.

blocks.alt: PET ka hissa bracket mein, subscript n: -C(=O)-benzene ring-C(=O)-O-CH2-CH2-O-. Chhota teer ester linkage ke C=O ki taraf ishara karta hai.
blocks.caption: PET ka hissa aur us ka ester linkage (kitab ke PDF safha 152 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Kevlar ka hissa: -N(H)-C(=O)-ring-C(=O)-N(H)-ring-N(H)-C(=O)-ring-C(=O)-N(H)-, har C=O oopar aur har N-H neeche, benzene rings ke darmiyan amide links.
blocks.caption: Kevlar ka hissa aur us ke amide linkages (kitab ke PDF safha 152 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
Hisse se polymer ki qism pehchanna (kitab ka Table 26.1)

blocks.alt: Addition polymer ka hissa: saat carbon ki khuli zanjeer, har doosre carbon par benzene ring aur baqi par H. Teer se repeat unit [-CH(C6H5)-CH2-]n bracket mein, phir doosre teer se monomer H2C=CH(C6H5) (phenylethene).
blocks.caption: Repeat unit aur monomer ki pehchan (addition) (kitab ke PDF safha 153 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Condensation polymer (Kevlar) ka hissa: -NH-CO-ring-CO-NH-ring-NH-CO-ring-CO-NH-. Teer se repeat unit [-NH-ring-NH-CO-ring-CO-]n. Teer se monomers: H2N-ring-NH2 aur HOOC-ring-COOH, ya ClOC-ring-COCl.
blocks.caption: Repeat unit aur monomers ki pehchan (condensation) (kitab ke PDF safha 153 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka; kitab ne '(addition)' likha).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab is khaake ke neeche bhi '(addition)' likhti hai, lekin Kevlar mein amide links hain aur yeh condensation polymer hai; hum ne caption mein condensation likha hai. Monomers wapas lane ke liye har amide link par paani daalein: C=O wali taraf -OH aur N wali taraf -H.

blocks.prompt: Polymerisation ki qism aur monomers batayein: (i) -CH2-NH-CO-CH2-NH-CO-; (ii) woh zanjeer jis ke har doosre carbon par phenyl group; (iii) polypropylene, -CH2CH(CH3)-CH2CH(CH3)-.
blocks.explanation: (i) Condensation (polyamide); monomer aminoethanoic acid (glycine), H2N-CH2-COOH (chhape hisse se parha gaya). (ii) Addition; phenylethene (styrene), CH2=CH-C6H5. (iii) Addition; propene, CH2=CH-CH3.

items: Sirf carbon ki reerh: addition; reerh mein O ya N: condensation.
Sab se chhote dohrane wale hisse ko bracket karein: repeat unit.
Monomers: C=C bahal karein, ya ester/amide links par paani daalein.
